### God Leaves the Temple
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/god-leaves-temple
Passage: Ezekiel 10:1-22
Points:
- God's presence is never confined to a single building, location, or sacred architecture.
- The Israelites falsely assumed the presence of the temple guaranteed immunity from divine judgment.
- Ezekiel’s vision revealed that the Lord was actively departing His sanctuary due to covenant unfaithfulness.
- The withdrawal of God's glory removed divine protection, opening Jerusalem to foreign conquest.
- God's mobility offered hope to the faithful remnant, assuring them He would accompany them in exile.
